description: This file defines the internal class SlabMemoryPool, a custom memory pool implementation for managing reusable byte memory blocks, including methods for leasing, returning, and slab allocation.

classes.name: SlabMemoryPool
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from MemoryPool<byte>, used to allocate and manage pooled memory blocks efficiently, including slab management and block leasing logic.

methods.name: Rent
methods.description: Overridden method to rent a memory block of specified size, leasing from the pool or allocating new slabs as necessary.

methods.name: Lease
methods.description: Private method to take a block from the pool, allocating a new slab if needed.

methods.name: AllocateSlab
methods.description: Creates a new memory slab, partitions it into blocks, and adds the blocks to the pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Returns a block to the pool for reuse, or disposes it if the pool is disposed.

methods.name: RefreshBlock
methods.description: Recreates and returns a block during finalization if necessary, used internally during slab disposal.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements IDisposable pattern to clean up slabs and blocks when the pool is no longer needed.
